result.query: Trace AMD's Tantalum smelter disclosures through mineral refining to the USGS top primary-producing country.
result.answer:
AMD discloses the following verified Tier-2/3 Tantalum smelters and refiners: AMG Brasil (BRAZIL), Mineracao Taboca S.A. (BRAZIL), F&X Electro-Materials Ltd. (CHINA), and NPM Silmet AS (ESTONIA) [CHUNK:CHK-SEC-SD-ISSUER-AMD].

According to the USGS, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda together supply over 60% of global primary tantalum ore [CHUNK:CHK-USGS-TANTALUM].

The provided documents do not explicitly state which primary-producing countries supply tantalum ore to AMD's disclosed smelters and refiners.

payload.sql:
SELECT
  base.chunk_id,
  base.doc_name,
  base.doc_type,
  base.page_number,
  base.content,
  base.data_origin,
  base.source_license,
  base.source_url,
  distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
  (SELECT * FROM `acc05_enterprise_graphrag.source_chunks` WHERE pack_id = @pack_id AND ARRAY_LENGTH(embedding) > 0),
  'embedding',
  (SELECT @query_embedding AS embedding),
  top_k => 6,
  distance_type => 'COSINE'
)
ORDER BY distance ASC
